purpose: A concise map of high-leverage Hapa foundation nodes. Each node is described as a reusable prototype or design foundation; consult its owning repository for current runtime and maturity state.

nodes.name: Hapa Second Brain
nodes.role: Private memory, source-aware retrieval, turn mining, provenance, and durable context packets.

nodes.name: Hapa Overcard
nodes.role: Shared card schemas and host contracts for typed, revisioned, auditable working state.

nodes.name: Hapa Telemetry
nodes.role: Node discovery, health, capability polling, dependency awareness, and operator visibility.

nodes.name: Hapa Overwind
nodes.role: Append-only history with rebuildable search and serving projections.

nodes.name: Hapa Quest Keeper
nodes.role: Cross-project board coverage, task history, evidence linkage, and delivery coordination.

nodes.name: Hapa Red Team
nodes.role: Scoped observation, findings, verification, repair memory, and explicit authority boundaries.

nodes.name: Hapa Neoblade / NeonBlade Operator
nodes.role: Canonical Design Guild system: tokens, Hapa Cards, operator panels, controls, graph treatments, semantic motion, accessibility rules, and formal UI audits.

nodes.name: Hapa Scroll Site
nodes.role: A source-aware cinematic explainer that turns verified clips, continuity evidence, and progressive Hapa Cards into an accessible scroll journey with static crawlable copy.
nodes.status: published prototype; inspect the source and story disclosures for clip and integration boundaries

nodes.name: Hapa Character Sheet
nodes.role: A presentation and curation node that turns Second Brain evidence into a public resume, Skill Codex, Proof Map, timeline, portfolio, and redaction-safe agent dossier.
nodes.status: public-safe dated projection; derived metrics are not employer ratings or current production metrics

connectionPattern: Second Brain supplies source-aware context; Overcard supplies the reusable record contract; Telemetry and Overwind expose operating state and history; Quest Keeper coordinates work; Red Team governs authority; NeonBlade gives these shared truth surfaces a consistent, accessible operator interface.
